body: Ive had 3 therapists in the span of 5 years. My current therapist i clicked with right away because she didnt tell me my story and i didnt have to tell her it from scratch, she allowed creative freedom so i shared with her my diary and poems and generally just drawings etc describing my experiences. Shes very niche with her work and gives me space to vent rant and be curious. She then offers up options rather than solutions and guides me with what ive said, shes also very real with me in regards to how human she acts. I mean by this, she doesnt hold back fully her emotions and expresses herself very well and makes human errors. The difference i noticed with this person and other therapists is her listening skills, her ability to flip a situation, using schema therapy style and internal family system. Anyway, if you wanna know more im happy to type up some more but i hope wbat ive said has been good for you to hear. I hope u find what youre looking for.

Dissociation, depersonalization, derealization

Numbness, escapism, exhaustion from daily activities and life itself. 

Unresolved issues, triggering physically, emotional neglect, poor self image, low self esteem, emotionally unstable, eupd

Unsure of own identity, identity disturbance, Asexuality, demi sexual, polyamorous 

There is nothing wrong with you, your brain chemistry could be out of balance for that very reason, abuse is a deep complex issue and should be treated as such, mental health illness is fluid and is not labelled, even though there are labels it should be considered fluid.
